text: [1] Since the law has only a shadow of the good things to come, [2] and not the very image of them, it can never make perfect those who come to worship by the same sacrifices that they offer continually each year. [AA]
Otherwise, would not the sacrifices have ceased to be offered, since the worshipers, once cleansed, would no longer have had any consciousness of sins?
But in those sacrifices there is only a yearly remembrance of sins, [AB]
for it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats take away sins. [AC]
For this reason, when he came into the world, he said: [3]"Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, [AD]but a body you prepared for me;
holocausts and sin offerings you took no delight in.
Then I said, 'As is written of me in the scroll,Behold, I come to do your will, O God.'"
First he says, "Sacrifices and offerings, holocausts and sin offerings, [4] you neither desired nor delighted in." These are offered according to the law. [AE]
Then he says, "Behold, I come to do your will." He takes away the first to establish the second. [AF]
By this "will," we have been consecrated through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all. [AG]
[5] Every priest stands daily at his ministry, offering frequently those same sacrifices that can never take away sins. [AH]
But this one offered one sacrifice for sins, and took his seat forever at the right hand of God; [AI]
[6] now he waits until his enemies are made his footstool.
For by one offering he has made perfect forever those who are being consecrated. [AJ]
[7] The holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying:
"This is the covenant I will establish with them after those days, says the Lord:'I will put my laws in their hearts,and I will write them upon their minds,'" [AK]
he also says: [8]"Their sins and their evildoingI will remember no more." [AL]
Where there is forgiveness of these, there is no longer offering for sin.
[9]Therefore, brothers, since through the blood of Jesus we have confidence of entrance into the sanctuary [AM]
[10] by the new and living way he opened for us through the veil, [AN] that is, his flesh,
[11] [AO] and since we have "a great priest over the house of God,"
let us approach with a sincere heart and in absolute trust, with our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience [12] and our bodies washed in pure water. [AP]
Let us hold unwaveringly to our confession that gives us hope, for he who made the promise is trustworthy. [AQ]
We must consider how to rouse one another to love and good works.
We should not stay away from our assembly, [13] as is the custom of some, but encourage one another, and this all the more as you see the day drawing near. [AR]
[14] [AS] If we sin deliberately after receiving knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains sacrifice for sins
but a fearful prospect of judgment and a flaming fire that is going to consume the adversaries. [AT]
Anyone who rejects the law of Moses [15] is put to death without pity on the testimony of two or three witnesses. [AU]

Do you not think that a much worse punishment is due the one who has contempt for the Son of God, considers unclean the covenant-blood by which he was consecrated, and insults the spirit of grace? [AV]
We know the one who said:"Vengeance is mine; I will repay,"and again:"The Lord will judge his people." [AW]
It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God. [AX]
Remember the days past when, after you had been enlightened, [16] you endured a great contest of suffering. [AY]
At times you were publicly exposed to abuse and affliction; at other times you associated yourselves with those so treated. [AZ]
You even joined in the sufferings of those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you had a better and lasting possession. [BA]
Therefore, do not throw away your confidence; it will have great recompense. [BB]
You need endurance to do the will of God and receive what he has promised. [BC]
"For, after just a brief moment, [17]he who is to come shall come;he shall not delay. [BD]
But my just one shall live by faith,and if he draws back I take no pleasure in him." [BE]
We are not among those who draw back and perish, but among those who have faith and will possess life.
